question: Average order value by category, top 5
ground_truth_sql: SELECT category, SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM catalog.schema.orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 5
generated_sql: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) / COUNT(orders) AS aov FROM catalog.schema.orders GROUP BY category
judge_rationale: Generated wrong measure: SUM(quantity)/COUNT(orders) instead of SUM(revenue)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)
expected_repair_hypothesis: Add example SQL teaching the correct AOV measure
